register_dataframe_accessor: register a custom accessor on DataFrame objects with a given name
register_series_accessor: register a custom accessor on Series objects with a given name
register_index_accessor: register a custom accessor on Index objects with a given name
create_accessor_class: create a custom accessor class that extends pandas DataFrame, Series, or Index with extension methods
delegate_class_methods: delegate methods and properties from a delegate class to a pandas accessor class
